content.value_statement: HyperFrames animation can fail when keyframes are not deterministic or visible at render time. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create seek-safe motion and verify proof frames.
actual_capabilities: Selects suitable keyframe mechanisms for HyperFrames compositions.
Guides GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, SVG, and 3D animation setup.
Defines deterministic runtime rules for render-critical motion.
Explains how to verify animation with lint, validate, keyframes, shot, and snapshot diagnostics.
Helps diagnose endpoint-only motion, identity breaks, fake depth, wrong finals, and unreadable text.
limitations: It does not plan full video structure or brand direction.
It does not source media, write captions, or produce narration.
It assumes a HyperFrames composition already exists or is being authored.
It cannot guarantee visual quality without running the recommended diagnostics.

use_cases.title: Create Deterministic Product Motion
use_cases.description: Build seek-safe product interface animation with clear poses, final holds, and verified proof frames.

use_cases.title: Debug HyperFrames Animation Failures
use_cases.description: Find why an animation resets, loses identity, lacks depth, or fails keyframe diagnostics.

use_cases.title: Add 3D Or SVG Motion
use_cases.description: Choose camera, path, stroke, morph, mask, or shader mechanisms that remain deterministic during rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Keyframes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple visible motion pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to animate this subject from its starting pose to a clear final pose. Keep the motion seek-safe and verify the final frame.

prompt_templates.title: Choose A Motion Mechanism
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request when the implementation path is unclear.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to choose the best mechanism for this animation. Compare GSAP, CSS keyframes, FLIP, path travel, or SVG draw where relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Fix A Failed Diagnostic
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging after keyframe or snapshot output looks wrong.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to inspect this failed motion result. Identify the animated subject, the missing proof pose, and the smallest source fix.

prompt_templates.title: Build Verified 3D Motion
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for depth, WebGL, shader, or camera motion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to create deterministic 3D or shader-driven motion. Include proof times, diagnostic angles, and final-state verification steps.

output_examples.input: Animate a card moving between two interface panels without losing identity.
output_examples.output: A plan using one continuous subject, source and target boxes, transform-based motion, a final hold, and focused proof snapshots.

output_examples.input: Diagnose why a 3D scene looks flat after rendering.
output_examples.output: A correction path that adds perspective, z travel, camera or world motion, occlusion checks, and angled proof frames.

output_examples.input: Make text enter with readable internal movement.
output_examples.output: A text motion approach using line or word subdivision, preserved line boxes, readable hold frames, and final fit checks.

best_practices: Name the moving subject and the visible poses before writing animation.
Use deterministic runtimes with finite duration, paused timelines, and registered instances.
Verify first frame, proof poses, final-minus-hold, and exact final with focused diagnostics.
anti_patterns: Do not use timers, unseeded randomness, hover triggers, or async-created timelines for render-critical motion.
Do not replace subject motion with helper overlays when continuity matters.
Do not end on black, reset to rest, or skip final-state verification unless requested.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create deterministic keyframe animation inside HyperFrames HTML compositions.

faq.question: Which animation runtimes does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, SVG techniques, DOM 3D, and WebGL patterns.

faq.question: Does it replace broader video planning skills?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on keyframe implementation and verification, not story, script, brand, or media planning.

faq.question: Can it help with failed renders?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides checks for missing poses, identity breaks, fake depth, wrong final frames, and unreadable text.

faq.question: Does it require command-line diagnostics?
faq.answer: It recommends HyperFrames lint, validate, keyframes, shot, and snapshot diagnostics for reliable verification.

faq.question: Is it useful for 3D animation?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains deterministic camera, object, material, shader, and depth verification patterns.
